How to use this service.description: How the SMTP-to-API-Gateway bridge works and the two ways to use it — a stored route (free) or per-enrollment routes (metered)

Python code example.description: Send an email through the gateway with smtplib and confirm it reached the target route

Shell code example.description: Send an email through the gateway with curl and confirm it reached the target route

default.description: Free | one API Gateway route stored as a customer secret

payload_format.description: Body shape POSTed to the target route: `email` (faithful envelope — sender, recipients, subject, text and html bodies, headers, attachments) or `apprise` (compact `{title, body, type, format}` notification envelope, what `notify` and the `msg-to-*` services accept).

target.description: Route on the UnitySVC API Gateway to forward to, relative to the gateway host — a service name (`notify`, `msg-to-discord`), an alias (`a/alerts`), a broadcast group (`b/relay`), or an enrollment (`e/XXXXXX`). No scheme, no leading slash.
